newsitem.title: finland: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER, GAP OVER BUNDS NARROWS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END FIRMER, GAP OVER BUNDS NARROWS.

text.p: 1615/1415 GMT - Bonds trim gap over Bunds with modest buying
interest at the long end, dealers say. Scope for further
narrowing to Germany seen if faith in convergence holds up,
dealers say. Eyes on U.S. data this week. Rangebound markka
about steady vs mark. DEM/FIM seen in tight 2.98-2.99 range.
*FIM-06 yld pct 5.93 vs 5.96 *06 gap over Bund bps 26 vs 31
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.48 vs 5.51 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.65 vs 3.67
*Mar FRAs pct 3.10 vs 3.11 *Dec FRAs pct 3.60 vs 3.61
